en.title: Inside Jiangnan Gongyuan: What Survives of Nanjing's Examination Halls?
en.headline: Read the Tower, Cells and Underground Museum Separately
en.description: Follow a gate-to-cell route through surviving fabric, reconstructed examination rooms and the modern museum below Nanjing's Jiangnan Gongyuan.
en.heroAlt: Mingyuan Tower behind rows of reconstructed examination cells at Jiangnan Gongyuan in Nanjing

heroCredit.text: Mingyuan Tower and reconstructed cells, photographed by ScareCriterion12 on 8 March 2018; centre-cropped and resized. The image must not be read as a wholly surviving imperial compound.

en.featuredLinkLabel: See what survives of Nanjing's exam halls
